scope: Hong Kong medical discovery — Chinese University of Hong Kong Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: CUHK publishes a 2026/27 MBChB admissions route and an international application guide with 2026 deadlines and a September teaching start.
CU Medicine's non-JUPAS information specifies international qualification requirements and test information, and confirms a four-year graduate-entry track as a distinct admission channel.
CUHK lists 2026/27 non-local undergraduate tuition at HKD 214,000 per annum and an estimated total annual student budget of about HKD 280,000, subject to individual costs.
The official 2026/27 almanac provides MBChB-specific teaching and examination periods through Years 1–6.

holdReasons: No independent current programme recognition/accreditation source was established for the necessary recognition badges.
CUHK's six-year undergraduate MBChB and four-year graduate-entry track are distinct routes; a complete payload must choose one and keep admissions/fees/curriculum strictly route-specific.
A complete current programme-level clinical, accommodation and international-support evidence packet was not completed.
nextAction: Confirm MBChB-specific professional accreditation/recognition and complete route-specific clinical and student-living evidence before packaging; do not merge the graduate-entry track into the six-year record.
